overview: REALCHAT is a real-time chat and video call web app where users sign in with Internet Identity, message each other live, and start one-on-one video calls.
features: Sign in with Internet Identity and manage a profile
Browse a directory of users to chat or call
Send and receive live one-on-one messages
Start one-on-one video calls with WebRTC
In-call controls for mute, camera, and end call
